description: Minimal source excerpts and paraphrases, with exact request-specific locators; not full original downloads or historical HTTP replay.

evidence.claim: RFC9146 has an explicitly identified official predecessor family.
History identifies09 as a substantive calculation change; it does not identify53 ownership.
The selected08 original has an unspecified extension enum. Its AEAD additional-data sequence places cid_length after cid and starts with seq_num.
Final RFC uses a sequence-number placeholder, repeated CID content type, cid_length before the version, and explicit epoch and sequence_number before cid. It does not provide the old08 expression.
Latest draft repeats the53 incompatibility notice but still only calls it a previous version, with no exact revision correspondence.
